Messages.Author: Reepicheep
Messages.Body:
During a recent game, my renegade garou was fighting a tremere and got hit
with a blood to water, killing him off. I was wondering when during the
combat the effect of blood to water took place. Is it a strike to be
taken care of during strike resolution, thus giving my ally a chance to
hit back, or does it take effect immediately before my strikes?

Our judgement during the game was that it took place immediately, but I
just wanted to doublecheck.

Darrell
--
There is a madness needed to touch the gods, yes, this is true. Few
mortals possess it, the willingness to step away from the protection of
sanity. To walk into the wild wood of madness... -Loki "The Kindly Ones"

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Reepicheep wrote:
>
> During a recent game, my renegade garou was fighting a tremere and got hit
> with a blood to water, killing him off. I was wondering when during the
> combat the effect of blood to water took place. Is it a strike to be
> taken care of during strike resolution, thus giving my ally a chance to
> hit back, or does it take effect immediately before my strikes?
>
> Our judgement during the game was that it took place immediately, but I
> just wanted to doublecheck.

You played it correctly. Blood to Water resolves immediately when
it is played - and it can only be played after range has been set
(and has been set to close - errata) and before strike resolution.
